fr_html: La proposition est rejetée. Il est expressément entendu que le no. 2 (alinéa 4) de l'article 29, doit rester tel qu'il est.
en_html: The proposal was rejected. It was expressly agreed that Number 2 (Paragraph 4) of Article 29 should remain as it was.
